preflight.credentialProbe: pair already performs a synthetic probe; do not routinely repeat doctor or inspect real credentials
preflight.olderCli: read that binary's --help; if guide/setup/status is unsupported report the version gap, do not invent replacement commands

trusted.setupFailure: this setup is not confirmed complete; existing grants may remain and current remote state is unknown; no automatic temporary downgrade

host_ready.requires: successful matching responses from the selected Host using the intended account and executable
host_ready.proves: MCP transport handshake only, not current cloud grant validity

localStatus.serverActiveConfirmedFalseMeans: not checked, not proof of revocation
localStatus.historicalSetupComplete: past completion only; not current host initialization or cloud validity
localStatus.serving: ready was acknowledged before entering stdio; not proof the Host initialized
localStatus.failureAction: stop delivering that QR; report the reason and actual process result, never keep a private waiting_approval flag

qr.delivery: local lossless PNG conversion, square with quiet zone; recheck generation after conversion before attaching
qr.controlUnavailable: use only the current live official pair process output; temporary use must remain Host-owned; report absent cross-process evidence, never fabricate status
qr.replaceRequested: queued only; deliver a new image only after the owner's new generation and waiting_phone; if phone approval wins, finish the original generation instead of waiting for a replacement
qr.imageName: unique session-generation filename; never reuse an old PNG or a cached attachment

timeouts.noProgressAction: if no QR or stage progress, inspect the same session and process once; report the stall, do not automatically kill a saving process or start parallel pairings
timeouts.toolTimeout: inspect the original owner first; a tool timeout alone does not establish owner exit or approval failure
timeouts.phoneWaiting: user waiting is not install work; show actual state and expiry, do not promise seconds until completion

boundaries: direct official CLI, not a custom handshake wrapper or daemon; a task runner may keep that same official process alive without replacing its state
no new systemd/launchd/supervisor service unless explicitly requested
no root or group/HOME substitution to borrow another user's credentials, no unlock/ACL relaxation or ordinary-file secrets
no content reads or real reminder writes for installation validation
only the user chooses phone scopes and trust mode; installation does not approve them
report installed, paired and host_ready separately; unverified stages remain unverified, terminal failure/expiry stays failed/expired rather than waiting
